expected_outcomes.candidate_gate: P03 and P04 currentness pass, P05 remains PASS, and all exact identities match this handoff.

known_limitations: The candidate is private and local; no package is published and the exact DomainSpec archive is materialized from P03-bound source before use.
The examples are deterministic synthetic commerce fixtures, not a production workload or customer-domain acceptance test.

Required validation covers installed check, build, verify, evidence inspection and tamper rejection; native signed-loopback behavior is existing P02 construction evidence, not silently relabelled as an owner result.
PostgreSQL, NATS JetStream, outbound HTTP, transport delivery, consumer completion, credentials, deployment and production operation are not exercised.
Dependency installation may require the declared npm or Python registry reads; Rust relies on the repository-locked toolchain and available locked cache.
The frozen candidate uses exact selected working-tree bytes and does not claim that the unrelated repository worktree is clean.
The experimental local-host layer is separate and is not a general production-host guarantee.
The qualified environment is Linux/WSL x64 with the exact tool identities recorded by P03; other platforms are not qualified by this handoff.
forbidden_inferences: A passing protocol is not product approval.
A passing protocol is not D65 or governance registration or admission.
A passing protocol grants no authority, activation, cutover, publication, release, deployment or operation decision.
Compilation and loopback evidence do not prove live-provider, customer, security, scale, reliability or production behavior.
Failure or not-evaluable results must remain visible and return to the responsible construction node; they never become an implicit PASS.
cleanup_requirement: All protocol consumers, archives, generated targets and logs stay under one task-owned temporary root and are removed only after the owner has copied any desired receipt to a separately selected location.
claim_ceiling: Ready product-owner validation handoff for the exact P03 candidate only. No product-owner result, product approval, registration, admission, authority, publication, release, deployment, production guarantee or external effect is claimed.
open_questions: The product owner must choose whether to execute the handoff and where any resulting receipt should be retained.
Any later product-approval request is a separate owner decision after current PASS evidence for every required test.
